name: Graylog WG PALO
summary: For collecting logs from WatchGuard and PANOS device

source.@value:
pipeline "PAN-OS Log Parser"
stage 1 match either
rule "panos extract traffic fields"
rule "panos extract threat fields"
stage 2 match either
rule "format palo integer fields"
rule "format palo boolean fields"
stage 0 match either
rule "pan detect and route traffic"
rule "pan detect and route threat"
end

pipeline "WatchGuard Log Parser"
stage 0 match either
rule "wg parse leef header"
stage 1 match either
rule "WG_catalog_firewall"
rule "WG_catalog_proxy_policy"
rule "WG_catalog_networking"
stage 2 match either
rule "wg extract leef attributes"
stage 4 match either
rule "format watchguard integer fields"
stage 3 match either
rule "normalize watchguard firewall to common schema"
end

pipeline "Default Routing"
stage 0 match EITHER
rule "gl_route_Syslog UDP - 514[6a153cb9ca115e5b3a0b5f73]_to_Syslog UDP - ALL"
end

pipeline "Device Router"
stage 0 match either
rule "tag site BKK HQ palo alto"
rule "tag site BKK HQ watchguard"
rule "tag site SPK PPD watchguard"
stage 1 match either
rule "route to panos"
rule "route to watchguard"
end

rule "panos extract threat fields"
when
  to_string($message.log_type) == "THREAT"
then
  set_fields(csv_to_map(
    value: to_string($message.message),
    fieldNames: ",receive_time,serial_number,type,subtype,,generated_time,src_ip,dst_ip,nat_src_ip,nat_dst_ip,rule_name,src_user,dst_user,application,vsys,src_zone,dst_zone,inbound_if,outbound_if,log_profile,,session_id,repeat_count,src_port,dst_port,nat_src_port,nat_dst_port,flags,protocol,action,url_filename,threat_id,category,severity,direction,seqno,actionflags,src_country,dst_country,,content_type,pcap_id,file_digest,cloud,url_idx,user_agent,file_type,xff,referer,sender,subject,recipient,report_id,,,,,vsys_name,device_name,,,,http_method,,,,,,threat_category,content_version,,,,http_headers,url_category_list,rule_uuid,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,high_res_timestamp,reason,justification,,app_subcategory,app_category,app_technology,app_risk,app_characteristic,app_container,tunneled_app,app_is_saas,app_sanctioned,cloud_report_id,flow_type,cluster_name",
    separator: ",",
    quoteChar: "\"",
    escapeChar: "\\",
    strictQuotes: false,
    trimLeadingWhitespace: true,
    ignoreExtraFieldNames: false,
    ignoreExtraCsvValues: true
  ));
end

title.@value: tag site BKK HQ palo alto

source.@value:
rule "tag site BKK HQ palo alto"
when
  $message.gl2_remote_ip == "172.17.88.3"
then
  set_field("site", "BKK_HO");
  set_field("device_vendor", "PaloAlto");
end

rule "route to panos"
when
  to_string($message.device_vendor) == "PaloAlto"
then
  route_to_stream("PAN-OS Logs");
end

rule "tag site BKK HQ watchguard"
when
  $message.gl2_remote_ip == "172.17.9.254"
then
  set_field("site", "BKK_HO");
  set_field("device_vendor", "WatchGuard");
end

title.@value: normalize watchguard firewall to common schema

source.@value:
rule "pan detect and route threat"
when
  contains(to_string($message.message), ",THREAT,")
then
  set_field("log_type", "THREAT");
end

rule "tag site SPK PPD watchguard"
when
  $message.gl2_remote_ip == "192.168.58.252"
then
  set_field("site", "SPK_PPD");
  set_field("device_vendor", "WatchGuard");
end

rule "gl_route_Syslog UDP - 514[6a153cb9ca115e5b3a0b5f73]_to_Syslog UDP - ALL"
when has_field("gl2_source_input") AND to_string($message.gl2_source_input)=="6a153cb9ca115e5b3a0b5f73"
then
route_to_stream(id:"6a1527b3ca115e5b3a0b30b7", remove_from_default: true);
end

rule "route to watchguard"
when
  to_string($message.device_vendor) == "WatchGuard"
then
  route_to_stream("WatchGuard Logs");
end

rule "pan detect and route traffic"
when
  contains(to_string($message.message), ",TRAFFIC,")
then
  set_field("log_type", "TRAFFIC");
end

rule "panos extract traffic fields"
when
  to_string($message.log_type) == "TRAFFIC"
then
    set_fields(csv_to_map(
        value: to_string($message.message),
        fieldNames: ",receive_time,serial_number,type,subtype,,generated_time,src_ip,dst_ip,nat_src_ip,nat_dst_ip,rule_name,src_user,dst_user,application,vsys,src_zone,dst_zone,inbound_if,outbound_if,log_profile,,session_id,repeat_count,src_port,dst_port,nat_src_port,nat_dst_port,flags,protocol,action,bytes,bytes_sent,bytes_received,packets,start_time,elapsed_time,category,,seqno,actionflags,src_country,dst_country,,pkts_sent,pkts_received,session_end_reason,,,,,vsys_name,device_name,action_source,,,,,,,,,,,,rule_uuid,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,high_res_timestamp,,,app_subcategory,app_category,app_technology,app_risk,app_characteristic,app_container,tunneled_app,app_is_saas,app_sanctioned,offloaded,flow_type,cluster_name",
        separator: ",",
        quoteChar: "\"",
        escapeChar: "\\",
        strictQuotes: false,
        trimLeadingWhitespace: true,
        ignoreExtraFieldNames: false,
        ignoreExtraCsvValues: true
    ));
end

rule "format palo boolean fields"
when
  to_string($message.device_vendor) == "PaloAlto"
then
  set_field("app_is_saas",    to_bool(lowercase(to_string($message.app_is_saas)) == "yes"));
  set_field("app_sanctioned", to_bool(lowercase(to_string($message.app_sanctioned)) == "yes"));
end
